content:
Harper (Growth): Heads-up 1 running a targeted newsletter + gated webinar for the benchmark launch next Thu. Need: 3-email registrant drip + 2-email rescue for clickers who drop off. Segments: product-fit (embeddings/text-gen), tier (SMB/Mid/Enterprise), engagement (high/med/low).
Sofia (Lifecycle): For high-engage: confirm + 48h highlight + 1hr reminder. Mid: confirm + 72h highlight. Low: confirm only + single soft nudge. VIP enterprise slice gets a concierge CTA.
Miles (Design): I'll make two hero templates (data-led, people-led) and a compact mobile header. Will include a case-study swap for Dedicated customers.
Omar (Analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_targeted_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Targets: high RSVP 17%, mid 7%, low 2.5%. Lead scoring: click +3, rsvp +6, attend +18. Audience est 49k (~6k high).
Izzy (Ops): Routing: tag `webinar_status=registered` -> campaign `bench_target_v1`. Webhook for finish-signup -> POST https://hooks.redwood/finish-signup. Dedicated clicks -> /ae/handoff. I'll add a rule: if account_tier=Enterprise + click -> AE queue.
Harper (Growth): Subject tests: A) "Benchmark highlights + 1chart" B) "What teams shipped" C) short "Benchmark highlights". Add preview text variants. Send windows: local 10am preferred; APAC 10:30 local. Avoid Mon mornings for Enterprise.
Omar (Analytics): QA: seed 50 internal addresses. I'll build a live dashboard (RSVP, CTR, click->rsvp, trial-start 7d) and run subject lift with RSVP as primary metric.
Sofia (Lifecycle): No-show microflow: 1) recording within 24h, 2) 10d follow-up with 3 product use-cases, 3) 2-week AE flag for high-value no-shows.
Harper (Growth): Owners: Harper (lead), Sofia (flows), Miles (creative), Omar (metrics), Izzy (routing). Can we have assets + test sends by Wed EOD?
